input: Compile a list of emergency home repair contacts

gold.taskTitle: Compile Emergency Home Repair Contacts List
gold.taskDescription: Build a organized list of reliable contacts to call for emergency home repair situations.

questions.title: Which specific repair trades must be covered?
questions.description: Identify the exact types of emergency repairs the user needs contacts for, such as plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing, locksmith, etc.

questions.title: What city or region are these contacts for?
questions.description: Determine the geographic location so that only locally available and reachable contractors are included.

questions.title: How many contacts per trade are needed?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a single primary contact per category or multiple backup options for each trade.

questions.title: What format should the final list be in?
questions.description: Find out whether the user wants a printed sheet, a phone note, a spreadsheet, a document, or another format for storing the contacts.

questions.title: Should contacts be verified as 24/7 available?
questions.description: Determine if it is essential that every contact on the list offers round-the-clock emergency availability, or if business-hours contractors are acceptable.

questions.title: Do you have existing contractors you already trust?
questions.description: Check if the user already has some known and vetted contacts to include, so research can focus only on the gaps.

questions.title: Should the list include insurance or warranty details?
questions.description: Clarify whether each contact entry should also capture information such as licensing, insurance status, or warranty terms alongside the phone number.
